Yale School of Music

To study music is to explore its past and engage with its present.

Keep scrolling to learn more.

Study
Yale School of Music offers its students an intimate and supportive environment in which to excel in their respective area of study.
Explore
Be it with musical instruments, manuscripts, or recordings, YSM provides ample resources for exploration, such as Morris Steinert Collection of Musical Instruments and other Yale resources.
Engage
With year-long performances in our concert halls, countless community initiatives, and the summer’s Norfolk Chamber Music Festival, YSM is engaged with the world at large.

Commencement

Congratulations, Class of 2026!

The Yale School of Music’s Commencement ceremony will be held on Monday, May 18, 2026, at 12PM, in Morse Recital Hall in Sprague Memorial Hall, following the Yale University ceremony on Old Campus.
